friendly.subject: {posts} for {period} — ready for your review
friendly.message: Hi {client_name}, {posts} for {period} are ready for your review. Please check each one and reply "approve" or tell me what to change by {deadline}. If I don't hear back by then, I'll hold the posts — nothing goes out without your yes.
friendly.follow_up_message: Hi {client_name}, a quick reminder: {posts} for {period} are still waiting for your review. Please reply "approve" or tell me what to change by {deadline}. Until I hear back, I'll hold the posts — nothing goes out without your yes.

formal.subject: For your approval: {posts} for {period}
formal.message: Dear {client_name}, {posts} for {period} are ready for your review. Please review each one and reply "approve", or let me know what should change, by {deadline}. If I have not heard from you by then, I will hold the posts. Nothing will be published without your approval.
formal.follow_up_message: Dear {client_name}, this is a reminder that {posts} for {period} are still awaiting your review. Please reply "approve", or let me know what should change, by {deadline}. Until I hear from you, the posts remain on hold. Nothing will be published without your approval.
